Bug 1973975 - Ensure that glMakeCurrent is called when rendering without presenting. r=gfx-reviewers,aosmond

Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D255987
agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix 94bca7f8515f on top of intro a1c509458615 via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (UseAfterFree): When rendering without presenting (present=false), the code skips calling mCompositor->BeginFrame(), which is responsible for calling MakeCurrent() to initialize the GL context. This causes wr_renderer_update() and wr_renderer_render() to execute OpenGL operations without a valid GL context being current. On systems with NVIDIA drivers, this can lead to the driver accessing freed memory or incorrect GL state, resulting in a use-after-free crash. The crash signature shows the issue occurs in libgdk-3.so.0 gdk_x11_app_launch_context_get_type, triggered during WebRender operations involving NVIDIA EGL libraries. Root cause: The bug was introduced in Bug 1961115 which added a 'present' flag to skip compositor work when rendering offscreen content. The original code always called mCompositor->BeginFrame() which internally calls MakeCurrent() to establish the GL context. After the change, when present=false, neither BeginFrame() nor MakeCurrent() was called, leaving the GL context in an undefined state. Subsequent calls to wr_renderer_update() and wr_renderer_render() then operate without a valid GL context, causing NVIDIA EGL drivers to potentially access freed or invalid memory.
